style: Instrumental horror film score, no vocals, no choir, no drum kit, no synth pop. Rural setting, slow, restrained, dread-building.

main_theme.prompt: Main theme: sparse prepared piano playing a melancholic pentatonic motif, long pauses, breathy flute answering phrases, low sustained cello underneath, distant wind. Very quiet, intimate, uneasy. Around 60 bpm. Ends softly on an unresolved note.

dread_bed.prompt: Ambient dread drone bed for a night scene: deep low drone, bowed metal textures, distant low thuds every few seconds, no melody, no rhythm groove, no build, constant even intensity from start to end, suitable for seamless looping.

tension.prompt: Tension layer: col legno and tremolo strings, nervous sul ponticello, a slow heartbeat-like low pulse around 60 bpm, constant intensity, no melody, no ending, suitable for looping under other music.

stingers.prompt: A sequence of separate horror stingers separated by about two seconds of total silence each: a bowed cymbal swell ending in an orchestral slam; an eerie pitch glide; a dissonant string cluster stab; a low brass and piano-cluster impact with a long tail.
